pages.brief: Moss the hedgehog waking up under a hedge on a damp grey morning, raindrops on the leaves.
A small red toy van left in the grass, a round spider web strung across its front, beaded with raindrops.
Moss the hedgehog looking up at the red toy van and its web, one paw raised.
Moss the hedgehog stepping back from the red toy van so the web stays whole.
Moss the hedgehog sitting on an upturned blue jug in the grass, waiting patiently beside the red toy van.
Warm sunshine on the garden, the web on the red toy van now dry and shining.
A small black beetle walking on the dry web on the red toy van, Moss watching from the blue jug.
Moss the hedgehog trotting off across the sunny grass, the web on the red toy van still whole behind him.
